in_marathi.name: Bhavnita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavnita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhava’ meaning ‘Desire, Emotion’, Bhavnita is a name for a girl that symbolizes the depth of emotions and desires. In Hinduism, it is believed that the name Bhavnita bestows the blessings of the goddess of emotions and desires, Saraswati.
